info.name: School Attendance Management System API
info.description: Select the "School Attendance - Local" environment, then run folders 01 to 11 in order against a fresh database (or use Run collection and deselect folder 12). Tokens and created ids are stored in collection variables automatically. Folder 12 deletes data and changes passwords - run it last, on purpose.

request.description: Use "Send and Download" to save the .xlsx file.
Revokes all tokens of the user. Log in again afterwards.
